name: Ramon
source:
While serving a prison sentence for money laundering, he's offered amnesty in return for working as a volunteer on Hive Island. Surrounded by the beautiful scenery on this man-made island, what is the reason for him being sent here?

[From the [url=https://twitter.com/sekaiproject/status/1260676717879926791]official Twitter account[/url]]
